_comment: The 'ashen approaches' that wrap the Nether core. Multiple cursed_wastes seeds surround the single nether_core seed, so a player walking from spawn toward the far north passes through ashen woodland / badlands before reaching the netherrack interior. No nether biomes here — those are in theme/nether_core.json so the Nether is one solid contiguous Voronoi cell, not a scattered mix.
